mapper.select: SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_NAME, GROUP_NAME, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, USE_YN FROM DEPT_INFO WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CODE_ID = #{code_id} ORDER BY CODE_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEPT_INFO (CODE_ID, CODE_NAME, GROUP_NAME, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, USE_YN) VALUES (#{code_id}, #{code_name}, #{group_name}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{use_yn})
